- Align stakeholders and owners (sales / procurement / security / technical)
- Confirm marketplace listing requirements and open questions
- Run a short security preflight so procurement has what it needs

Internal folks I'm looping in: Karthik (partnerships), Laura (enablement), Priyom (marketplace ops). Karthik would lead the joint account plan from our side.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-Summary.pdf (summary), PayerLink_Security_Questions_2027.xlsx (security questionnaire)

Thanks — looking forward to kickstarting this.

Best,
